Package logic

Class EntryCheckRequest

java.lang.Object
logic.EntryCheckRequest
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class EntryCheckRequest extends Object implements Serializable
request sent by a park employee to check in a visitor at the gate.

the server first looks for a confirmed booking for today. if found, numVisitors and orderType are ignored and the booking values are used instead. if no booking exists, those fields describe the walk-in entry.

sent as the payload of CHECK_IN_VISITOR.
